description: Register a RampResource (OAuth2 client_credentials grant against a Ramp Developer App) wrapping Ramp's Developer API for use by other components. Exposes mileage/receipt reimbursement creation, Vault-API virtual card creation, and physical-card display_name/fund_id/automatic_routing_enabled updates -- there is no spend-limit update endpoint, by design (Ramp's API has none).

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

client_id_env_var.label: Client ID Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding your Ramp Developer App's Client ID.

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding your Ramp Developer App's Client Secret.

base_url.label: Base Url
base_url.description: Ramp Developer API base URL ('https://demo-api.ramp.com' for Sandbox).

vault_base_url.label: Vault Base Url
vault_base_url.description: Optional dedicated Vault API host for create_virtual_card. Leave unset unless Ramp tells you otherwise.

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Space-separated OAuth scope(s) requested at token time. Add 'cards:read_vault limits:write funds:write' for create_virtual_card (requires Ramp's production access review -- works in Sandbox for all customers).

token_path.label: Token Path
token_path.description: Token endpoint path, relative to base_url.

name: Ramp Resource
